result.instructions: Tools for SmartrMail, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our subscriber lists exist, and how many people are on each?"; "Is jane@example.com still subscribed, and when did she last open an email?"; "Create a new list called Spring Launch and rename the old Newsletter list to Newsletter 2026.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SmartrMail data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run smartrmail_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run smartrmail_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run smartrmail_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. smartrmail_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: smartrmail_list_lists
tools.title: List subscriber lists
tools.description: List all subscriber lists in the account, with each list's id, name and subscriber count. Good first call to find a list_id. SmartrMail API: GET /lists.

tools.name: smartrmail_get_list
tools.title: Get a subscriber list
tools.description: Get one subscriber list by id: its name and subscriber count. SmartrMail API: GET /lists/{list_id}.

tools.name: smartrmail_get_subscriber
tools.title: Get a subscriber
tools.description: Get one subscriber by email address, phone number or UID: contact fields, subscribed state, unsubscribed_at, delivery, open and click counts, and custom fields. SmartrMail API: GET /subscribers/{id}.

subscriber_id.description: The subscriber's email address, phone number, or UID (for example a phone number in E.164 form).

tools.name: smartrmail_create_list
tools.title: Create a subscriber list
tools.description: Create a new subscriber list with a name. Each call creates a new list. SmartrMail API: POST /lists.

tools.name: smartrmail_rename_list
tools.title: Rename a subscriber list
tools.description: Change the name of one subscriber list. Repeating the same call leaves the list unchanged. SmartrMail API: PUT /lists/{list_id}.

name.description: The new name for the list.

tools.name: smartrmail_update_subscriber
tools.title: Update a subscriber
tools.description: Update a subscriber's name, phone, subscribed flag or custom fields. Only the fields you pass change. Custom fields are matched by field_name. Repeating the same call leaves the subscriber unchanged. SmartrMail API: PUT /subscribers/{id}.

subscriber_id.description: The subscriber's email address, phone number, or UID (for example a phone number in E.164 form).

subscribed.description: Set false to mark as unsubscribed, true to mark as subscribed.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields to set or update.

value.description: Field value. Use YYYY-MM-DD for date and birthday types.

tools.name: smartrmail_unsubscribe_subscriber
tools.title: Unsubscribe a subscriber
tools.description: Unsubscribe a subscriber so they receive no more campaigns. Changes only the subscription status; custom field data stays. SmartrMail API: POST /subscribers/{id}/unsubscribe.

subscriber_id.description: The subscriber's email address, phone number, or UID (for example a phone number in E.164 form).

tools.name: smartrmail_resubscribe_subscriber
tools.title: Resubscribe a subscriber
tools.description: Mark a subscriber as subscribed again. Does not trigger list welcome automations. Custom field data stays. SmartrMail API: POST /subscribers/{id}/resubscribe.

subscriber_id.description: The subscriber's email address, phone number, or UID (for example a phone number in E.164 form).
